board.note: Confirmed by the owner at these values on 2026-11-23. T2 actions within these limits run without Board approval; T3 needs the owning executive plus a co-signer; T4 always needs the Board.

act in breach of law in any operating jurisdiction

principles: Humans approve all T4 actions; silence is not consent
